allowedLanguages.title: Allowed languages
allowedLanguages.description: Language codes such as en, ur, ar or pt-BR. Empty = any language.

markerWords.title: Marker words
markerWords.description: For languages written in Latin letters: one line per language, for example `tl: po salamat ako`.

strict.title: Strict check
strict.description: A reply must also match the visitor’s language by its share of marker words.
